user.title: Energydash
user.description: Everything is calculated locally in Home Assistant; nothing is sent to the cloud. Suggestions come from your Energy dashboard.

data.solar_mode: What does power from your own solar panels cost?

data_description.import_entity: kWh counter of your smart meter (P1) for imported energy.
data_description.solar_mode: Applies to all devices. Solar goes to the rest of the house first; only what is left counts as solar for the device.
data_description.export_entity: Optional. Needed together with solar production to calculate the rest of the house.
data_description.solar_entity: Optional. kWh counter of your inverter.

data_description.price_entity: Sensor in €/kWh including taxes. A forecast attribute with quarter or hour prices is used automatically.
data_description.export_price_entity: Optional. Without it the price excluding taxes from the forecast is used, if available.
data_description.export_price_fixed: Optional. Used when there is no feed-in price entity or forecast.
